item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-R02-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Tribunal Electoral record presents final vote tabulations for the presidential election by entity and district, listing Andrés Manuel López Obrador and other candidates and including a total line.","notes":["The excerpt supports final tabulations, candidate names, district/entity entries, and totals.","It does not support the characterization of the process as formally administered or competitive, a specific 2018 date, or the causal claim that López Obrador obtained the presidency through this process."]}]}
